A live preview of every component in the IAM-CC UI guidelines. Change tokens on the left; everything here is sized in rem and recoloured from the same variables.

Colour

Dark Azure does the work; Pastel Coral is rare and deliberate. Contrast against white is shown on each swatch.

Typography

One typeface everywhere. Minimum size 0.75rem. Sentence case for headings, buttons and labels.

Layout

A spacing base unit, generous rounding and soft azure-tinted shadows. Resize the preview width to see the grid switch between 4, 8 and 12 columns.

Buttons

One accent (coral) button per screen at most. Labels are verb first, one to three words. Tab through the live row to check focus rings.

Charts and maps

Series colours are used in order and never cycled. One y-axis per chart. A legend for two or more series, direct labels on up to four, and a table view.
